 Agreed Compliance Measures
 I, Jason George Glover, hereby declare that:
1. By reason of reason of my appointment as a permanent member of the Veterans Review and Appeal Board on December 14, 2020, I am a reporting public office holder subject to the Conflict of Interest Act (“Act”). 
2. I have an ownership interest in J.G. Capital Investment Corporation, a private corporation, whose corporate assets include one account composed of “controlled assets” as defined in section 20 of the Act (controlled asset);
3. On April 9, 2021, I agreed to place all of my shares of J.G. Capital Investment Corporation in a blind trust (my blind trust); This declaration is a preventive compliance measure, agreed upon pursuant to section 29 of the Act by a public office holder and the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, to assist the public office holders in avoiding conflicts of interest. 
The Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and I have agreed that this declaration is an appropriate compliance measure for me, aimed at preventing any opportunity, while I exercise my official powers, duties and functions as a reporting public office holder, to further my private interests by giving instructions or receiving consultations with director or the trustee of my corporation, J.G. Capital Investment Corporation. 
4. In order to comply with the requirements of the Act, the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner determined that the following additional compliance measures are required:
a. Except for general written investment instructions pre-approved by the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, I will not otherwise instruct, direct or advise the Trustee of my blind trust and J.G. Capital Investment Corporation., including its director(s) or anyone else acting on the corporation’s behalf, with respect to the management, disposition or investment of the corporation’s controlled assets. 
b. I will also refuse any request for consultation, instruction, direction or advice by the Trustees of my blind trust or J.G. Capital Investment Corporation including its director(s) or anyone else acting on the corporation’s behalf, with respect to the management, disposition or investment of the controlled assets held by the corporation.
c. I will not participate in any discussions or decision-making processes involving the management, disposition or investment of the controlled assets of J.G. Capital Investment Corporation. 
d. I undertake to instruct the Trustees of my blind trust and J.G. Capital Investment Corporation, its director(s) or anyone else acting on its behalf, that they are not to provide me with any information relating to the corporation’s controlled asset investments, other than information that is required by law to be filed by me and also periodic reports on the overall value of the corporation’s controlled assets.
e. I undertake to inform the Trustees of my blind trust and J.G. Capital Investment Corporation of the additional compliance measures set out in paragraphs a, b and c and the requirement to return to the Office of the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner an executed copy of the Acknowledgement found in Annex A. 
f. I will obtain the pre-approval of the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner before appointing any other person or corporation as trustee of the blind trust.
5. The terms of this agreed compliance measure will remain in place for as long as I am considered a reporting public office holder subject to the Act.
